hero.title: Why Study Pharmacy in Ireland?
hero.subtitle: Ireland offers world-class MPharm and Pharmaceutical Sciences degrees accredited by the Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland (PSI), combining rigorous clinical pharmacology with an 8-month paid clinical placement.

overview: Students interested in Pharmacy in Ireland benefit from internationally recognized university degrees at RCSI, Trinity College Dublin, and University College Cork, alongside strong pharmaceutical industry links and PSI registration pathways.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide helps Indian students shortlist top Irish pharmacy schools, verify academic and IELTS requirements, prepare applications, and manage student visa documentation.
